about: Steps on find and go to line, written by hand. Each step acts on the view of text (scanned as kind) and is followed by what is expected: count is the number of matches, current the [line, start] of the current match or null, visible the visible lines (only where the text is short enough to list), hidden lines that must not be drawn, shown a line whose row must lie inside the window, top the first line whose row lies whole inside the window.
